scope: Filtered acquire bug fix, actual Rust dedup proof, completion finite model, and independently reviewable environment contracts

tlc.note: Matching results/counts is regression evidence, not a formal equivalence proof

limitations: p99 is observational, not a hard clock/visibility deadline
Timing includes local control processing and WAL fsync but excludes RPC network transport and other round-trip steps
Completion/replay is a finite model, not an unbounded whole-API Rust proof
Verus eventual stage success remains a direct environment premise; no derivation from I/O recovery and fairness
No new 100 GB throughput or GC-scale claim

publication_redaction.scope: Public summary with deployment identifiers and private artifact locations removed.
publication_redaction.provenance: Embedded source/tool hashes describe the original execution inputs. This redacted JSON is not byte-identical to the original private record and is not a replacement for raw proof logs.
